integrity: The proof reconstructs every crosspolytope facet normal from the path differences, applies the zero-sum variance identity, and proves a sharp partial-sum bound with exactly two equality sign patterns. Opposite extremal facets give a global inradius upper bound for every translated ball. Strict slack at the remaining facets proves the codimension-one incenter family. Opposite vertex pairs independently certify the unique minimum enclosing sphere.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the unweighted path in the standard symmetric-edge realization and intrinsic Euclidean balls in its zero-sum affine span. Weighted paths and general trees are not covered. The incenter locus is given by a complete finite inequality description, but its own vertex enumeration is not determined.
title: Path symmetric edge polytopes have an exact inradius and a codimension-one incenter family
